facts.fact: Before P169, ghclient execRunner.Run in runner.go buffered all gh stdout unbounded, then sliced to maxStdoutBytes (4 MiB) afterwards.
Before P169, memory not bounded; nothing recorded that stdout was cut.
Before P169, stderr had same post-hoc slice, maxStderrBytes (1 MiB).
Before P169, Client.get returned forbidden with 'GitHub returned an unreadable response' when cut body was invalid JSON.
Before P169, Client.graphql returned OK with no data on cut body, because classify says OK on exit 0, so PullFiles reported 'not found, or you cannot see it'.
Before P169, SetFilesViewed (out == nil) read cut body as success.
In ghclient only four gh calls carry a body: PullsForCommit, PullsForBranch, OpenPulls, PullFiles.
PullsForCommit uses REST commits/{sha}/pulls?per_page=10; PullsForBranch uses REST pulls?head=…&per_page=5.
OpenPulls uses REST pulls?state=open&per_page=100&page=1..3.
PullFiles uses GraphQL files(first:100) projecting only path and viewerViewedState, under 1 MiB per page.
Discovery.probe output tiny.
Real size exposure is OpenPulls, 100 full pull objects per page; no REST call fetches files or reviews.
Estimated OpenPulls pull item without body about 15-30 KiB (arithmetic, not measured).
Pull body max 65536 chars, about 384 KiB JSON-escaped worst case; per-item worst case about 450 KiB (estimate).
Estimated realistic 100-item OpenPulls page 2-4 MiB; worst case about 45 MiB (arithmetic, not measured).
P169 rejected per-endpoint --jq projection: D4 (G24 plan) rejected --jq as second expression language kept in step with rawPull.
P169 also rejected --jq because classify reads GitHub's error body from stdout, so filter could lose SSO/scope message.
P169 also rejected --jq because it fixes only REST calls.
P169 rejected smaller REST pages: break D7's rate-limit arithmetic (maxSnapshotPages = 3), bound nothing.
--paginate stays rejected per D4.
Moving OpenPulls to GraphQL out of scope for P169: changes rate-limit accounting and snapshot data path.
P169 decision (Option C): raise gh stdout cap to 64 MiB (maxStdoutBytes = 64<<20), enforced while reading.
64 MiB cap derives from about 45 MiB OpenPulls worst-case page; same figure as Studio import cap and Wails streamMaxFrameBytes.
maxStderrBytes stays 1 MiB.
maxStdoutBytes and maxStderrBytes become vars, not consts, so tests can lower them.
With P169 cap, memory grows only with real output; D4 stays as written, no new dependency, rate-limit change or wire-type change.
ghclient runner uses unexported boundedWriter (bytes.Buffer, max, overflow flag) for cmd.Stdout and cmd.Stderr.
boundedWriter.Write appends up to remaining capacity, sets overflow when bytes dropped, always returns len(p), nil.
boundedWriter.Write must never return error: would stop os/exec copy goroutine, close pipe and SIGPIPE gh, giving failed exit instead of 'too large'.
Result gains StdoutTruncated bool, set on both exit-0 and ExitError returns; zero value keeps fake Runners compiling.
gitclient has similar writer type, but unexported in another package with stderr-marker logic, so not shared.
ghclient classify, when res.StdoutTruncated (checked after runErr branch, before exit-0), returns Status{Kind: KindForbidden, Reason: tooLargeReason()}.
tooLargeReason() is func, not const, producing "GitHub's response was over %d MiB, too large to read" from maxStdoutBytes>>20.
facts.reason: Stated in P169-gh-large-responses.md, Changes. A func lets tests that lower the cap get a true message.

facts.fact: Too-large Kind stays forbidden, catch-all for GitHub-side answers app cannot use; 5xx uses it too.
isRateLimited does not match too-large reason, so D7's breaker not armed.
Status.Kind keeps four values, so no frontend change; only Reason text differs.
ghclient errors.go const reasonUnreadable = "GitHub returned an unreadable response" now means only non-JSON from untruncated body.
reasonUnreadable used in api.go get and two graphql.go literals.
In Client.graphql, when envelope does not decode, classify(repo.Host, res, nil, nil) runs first; non-OK result, including too large, is returned.
In Client.graphql, if classify says OK (exit 0) but envelope did not decode, returns forbidden with reasonUnreadable.
Exit-0 non-JSON stdout never OK, so PullFiles no longer says 'not found'.
Existing errors[]-without-data handling in Client.graphql unchanged.
pr.go OpenPulls with oversize pages: page 2 or 3 fail-open keeps partial snapshot when later page too large.
pr.go OpenPulls returns status when page 1 too large.
gitsession reads Status via Kind, OK() and isRateLimited, never by matching Reason text.
Nothing outside ghclient matches "unreadable response".
Residual risk: gh body near 64 MiB on slow link may exceed apiTimeout (10 s), reporting 'did not respond within 10s'.
apiTimeout residual risk accepted as honest, because realistic pages are 2-4 MiB.
Do not raise apiTimeout without measurement.
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, in 'GitHub authentication is delegated entirely to gh' paragraph, records gh stdout capped at 64 MiB while reading.
ARCHITECTURE.md derives 64 MiB cap from 100-item open-PR page worst case.
ARCHITECTURE.md records overflow reports forbidden with too-large reason, never 'unreadable response'.
D4 lives in G24 plan, not ARCHITECTURE, so no D4 amendment in ARCHITECTURE.
ARCHITECTURE.md has Known open item: gh response sizes estimated, not measured (P169).
P169 size measurement is user-run, non-blocking open item, because sandbox has no authenticated gh.
Measurement: on machine with gh auth login, fetch open pulls pages 1-3 (per_page=100, sort=updated, direction=desc) for large public repos, e.g. kubernetes/kubernetes, microsoft/vscode.
Measurement: use wc -c for bytes per page, time page 1, record both in plan's result section.
Delete Known open item if pages well under 64 MiB and wall time well under 10 s.
If real page exceeds few tens of MiB or nears 10 s, open named SPEC.md follow-up phase (GraphQL-projected snapshot), as that is design change.
TestOpenPulls_LargePage is P169 acceptance test, using fake gh script via real NewExecRunner.
TestOpenPulls_LargePage generates fixture in t.TempDir() of 100 rawPull-shaped objects, about 48 KiB body each, over 4<<20.
TestOpenPulls_LargePage subtests: default cap gives OpenPulls OK with 300 PRs; lowered cap gives forbidden with tooLargeReason().
In lowered-cap subtest fake script exits 0, so writer never SIGPIPEs child.
TestPullFiles_TooLargeAndUnreadable (graphql_test.go) covers StdoutTruncated and non-JSON exit-0 outcomes.
P169 has no separate boundedWriter test.
P169 scope Go only (ghclient plus docs); implemented as planned, no deviations.
